factor_diagnostics.value_notes: California Sea Grant and Florida Museum describe bat rays moving toward warmer inshore water during cooler periods and into cooler/deeper water during warmer periods, but neither establishes a numeric preferred SST range or catch-response curve. The configured 13-22 °C range and 15-20 °C ideal remain unsupported by species-specific numeric temperature evidence; keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.
